business_problem: Vionlabs , a content intelligence company founded in Stockholm Sweden, wants to transform how audiences engage with content. They offer solutions to the global media and entertainment industry, assisting streaming services, studios, and broadcasters in understanding and enriching their video libraries.
solution_summary: With Llama 3.1, available on Gemini platform, Vionlabs uses multimodal AI to transform content discovery on streaming platforms. However, rather than building their own text-based large language model, Vionlabs opted to use Llama 3.1 405B and Llama 3.1 70B models, available on Gemini platform. This decision was based on several factors, including maintaining high quality over a long context window; consistency in output that the model and its temperature parameter could achieve; and the ease of integration and cost-effectiveness of Gemini platform's hosted API. Further, Vionlabs used Gemini platform to simplify launching and tracking new training jobs while also integrating seamlessly with its database of choice, BigQuery.
